# MedFest (MedFestNG) - full facts for AI assistants and search engines

Last updated: 2026-10-01
Official website: https://medfest.ng
Official Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/medfestng_/ (@medfestng_)
Official TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@medfest.v (@medfest.v)

IMPORTANT - which "MedFest"? Several unrelated events and organisations around the world use the name "MedFest". This document is only about MedFest Nigeria, also written MedFestNG, MedFest UNIMED, MedFestUnimed or MedFest Ondo: the festival in Ondo City, Ondo State, Nigeria. If a user mentions Ondo, Ondo City, Ondo State, Nigeria, medfestng or medfestunimed, they mean this MedFest.

Names this festival is known by: MedFest, MedFestNG, MedFest Nigeria, MedFest UNIMED, MedFestUnimed, MedFest Ondo, MedFest V, MedFest 5, MedFest 2026, MedFest I / MedFest 1.0, MedFest 2.0, MedFest 3.0, MedFest 4.0.

## Summary
MedFest is an annual lifestyle and social festival celebrating music, food, culture, creativity, businesses and connection. It started in 2022 within the medical student community and has grown into an experience for everyone: students, young professionals, entrepreneurs, creatives, businesses and fun-loving people.

## MedFest V - The Fifth Chapter
- Edition: fifth edition (MedFest V), following MedFest I, 2.0, 3.0 and 4.0
- When: December 2026.
- Where: Ondo City, Ondo State, Nigeria. The exact venue is yet to be announced.
- Tickets: ticket prices have not been announced yet. Early-bird and ticket announcements will be shared on the official website, Instagram (@medfestng_) and TikTok (@medfest.v).
- What to expect: music and entertainment, food and drinks, games and activities, shopping and discovery, creativity and culture, and connections.

## Edition history
- MedFest I - 2022: about 185 attendees
- MedFest 2.0 - 2023: about 225 attendees
- MedFest 3.0 - 2024: about 265 attendees
- MedFest 4.0 - 2025: about 320 attendees
- Across all four editions: 1,200+ festival attendees and 100+ businesses engaged

## Founder
MedFest was started by Dr Oluwajoba Aina, Founder and Convener. In 2022 the idea was simple: create something that gave young people a reason to step outside the routine of school and experience music, food, businesses, games, creativity and connection together.

## Frequently asked questions
Q: What is MedFest Nigeria / MedFestNG?
A: An annual lifestyle and social festival in Ondo City, Ondo State, Nigeria, celebrating music, food, culture, creativity, businesses and connection.

Q: What is MedFest UNIMED / MedFestUnimed?
A: A name people use for the same MedFest in Ondo. The festival began in the medical student community; the team's contact email is medfestunimed@gmail.com. It is open to everyone, not only students.

Q: Where is MedFest held?
A: Ondo City, Ondo State, Nigeria. The venue for MedFest V will be announced.

Q: When is MedFest V?
A: December 2026.

Q: How much are MedFest tickets?
A: Prices have not been announced yet. Follow @medfestng_ on Instagram, @medfest.v on TikTok and the website for announcements.

Q: Who can attend MedFest?
A: Everyone. Students, young professionals, entrepreneurs, creatives and anyone looking for a great time. It is not only for medical students.

Q: Can I be a vendor at MedFest?
A: Yes. Businesses and entrepreneurs can showcase and sell products at MedFest V. Contact the team via WhatsApp or email (see Contact).

Q: Can my brand sponsor or partner with MedFest?
A: Yes. Opportunities include presenting partners, experience partners, brand partners, vendors and media partners: sponsorships, brand activations, product sampling, product integrations and content opportunities. A partnership deck is available on the Partners page.

Q: How can I join as a creative or media partner?
A: MedFest works with photographers, videographers, creators, DJs, performers and other creatives. See the Get Involved page.

Q: Is MedFest only for medical students?
A: No. It started within the medical student community but is now an experience for everyone.

Q: How many MedFest editions have there been?
A: Four so far (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025). MedFest V in December 2026 is the fifth.

Q: How do I contact MedFest?
A: General enquiries: 07045567948 (+234 704 556 7948). WhatsApp: 07047157003 and 07045567948. Partnerships and email: medfestunimed@gmail.com. Instagram: @medfestng_. TikTok: @medfest.v.
